future_request_body_rule: Read the frozen A/B request files as bytes; revalidate hashes and only-excerpt diff before any call; do not reconstruct or update model-visible IDs/metadata.
future_gate: Use existing tested single-attempt transport and two-attempt persistent gate, after a separately reviewed input binding/order adapter. Do not run the old default/scrapy identity runner on these new arms without checking its fixed binding.
future_failure_rule: A failed arm consumes its attempt; the other frozen arm may run once within the same two-attempt authorization. Never retry failures, fix JSON, alter parameters, or replace an arm to seek success.
stop_before_any_call: Any input/source/constructor hash or field diff mismatch
Cannot demonstrate at most two attempts/no retries/no redirects
stop_after_pair: Both attempts used regardless of outcome
Record different/missing fingerprints as confounded, not proof of presentation effect
No automatic reverse-order replication, extra arm, prompt edit, Expand, Agent or full lab run
future_replication: One new pair is exploratory; reverse order and additional preregistered pairs require their own task authorization and budget. Do not use historical A as a substitute for a contemporaneous control.
